params.caption: 🎮 Modern Warfare 4 reportedly turns up skill-based matchmaking in DMZ Infinity Ward has reportedly adjusted DMZ matchmaking in Modern Warfare 4 so player skill counts for more when lobbies are built. The change comes even as SBMM in the game's regular multiplayer has drawn backlash from players. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 13:32 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto 👥 @CallofDuty 👍 or 👎 on stronger SBMM? · 💬 Tell us how your DMZ lobbies feel #ModernWarfare4 #DMZ #CallOfDuty #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
